name: How long does a typical interior painting project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical interior painting project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an interior painting project varies depending on the scope. A single room might take 1-2 days, while an entire multi-room home could span 3-7 days. Factors like surface preparation (patching, sanding), the number of coats required, and furniture moving all influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after an on-site assessment, ensuring clear communication about expected completion times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior painting projects vary: a single room takes 1-2 days, a whole house 3-7 days. Duration depends on prep work, coats, and furniture moving.
